en: Spring months is the 8th of the 24 solar tons.
zh: 春季是二十四節氣中的第八個節氣。
ja: 春の月は24節気のうちの8番目です。
local: Spring months is the 8th of the 24 solar tons.
ja_pron: Haru no tsuki wa nijūyon sekki no uchi no hachibanme desu.
native: Spring months is the 8th of the 24 solar tons.

en: This year it falls on May 21st.
zh: 今年它落在五月二十一日。
ja: 今年は5月21日にあたります。
local: This year it falls on May 21st.
ja_pron: Kotoshi wa gogatsu nijūichi-nichi ni atarimasu.
native: This year it falls on May 21st.

en: As its Chinese name, Xiaomi suggests, it is a period of time when greens are beginning
zh: 正如它的中文名稱“小滿”所暗示的，這是一段綠色植物開始
ja: 中国語の名前「小満」が示すように、これは緑が芽生え始める時期です。
local: As its Chinese name, Xiaomi suggests, it is a period of time when greens are beginning
ja_pron: Chūgokugo no namae 'Xiaomi' ga shimesu yō ni, kore wa midori ga mebae hajimeru jiki desu.
native: As its Chinese name, Xiaomi suggests, it is a period of time when greens are beginning

en: to ripen but not quite there yet.
zh: 成熟但尚未完全成熟的時期。
ja: 実り始めていますが、まだ完全には成熟していません。
local: to ripen but not quite there yet.
ja_pron: Minori hajimeteimasu ga, mada kanzen ni wa seijuku shiteimasen.
native: to ripen but not quite there yet.

en: During this period, some are forced throughout the whole country, while precipitation
zh: 在這段期間，全國各地有些地方會被迫，降水量
ja: この期間中、全国の一部では強制されることがあり、降水量は
local: During this period, some are forced throughout the whole country, while precipitation
ja_pron: Kono kikan-chū, zenkoku no ichibu de wa kyōsei sareru koto ga ari, kōsuiryō wa
native: During this period, some are forced throughout the whole country, while precipitation

en: China is a vast country with different landscapes.
zh: 中國是一個擁有多樣地形的廣大國家。
ja: 中国は多様な地形を持つ広大な国です。
local: China is a vast country with different landscapes.
ja_pron: Chūgoku wa tayō na chikei o motsu kōdaina kuni desu.
native: China is a vast country with different landscapes.

en: During this solar ton, we can experience coolness in the northern enjoying the summer sunshine
zh: 在這個節氣期間，我們可以在北方感受到涼爽，享受夏日陽光
ja: この節気の間、北部では涼しさを感じ、夏の日差しを楽しむことができます。
local: During this solar ton, we can experience coolness in the northern enjoying the summer sunshine
ja_pron: Kono sekki no aida, hokubu de wa suzushisa o kanji, natsu no hizashi o tanoshimu koto ga dekimasu.
native: During this solar ton, we can experience coolness in the northern enjoying the summer sunshine

en: in the southern and admire the snowy mountains and the Qinghai Tibet battle.
zh: 在南方欣賞雪山和青海西藏高原。
ja: 南部では雪山や青海チベット高原を鑑賞できます。
local: in the southern and admire the snowy mountains and the Qinghai Tibet battle.
ja_pron: Nanbu de wa yukiyama ya Seikai Tibet Kōgen o kanshō dekimasu.
native: in the southern and admire the snowy mountains and the Qinghai Tibet battle.
